title: Weighted Rademacher summand
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a$ assign a real number $a_i$ to each coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x$ be a point of the Boolean cube. For each coordinate $i$, the corresponding summand is $a_i$ multiplied by the sign of the $i$th coordinate of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real-valued function on the coordinates
$x$ is a point of the Boolean cube
